# Sotto

> Ultra-fast, zero-friction voice dictation & HUD for Windows and Linux built with 100% Rust, Slint, Groq Whisper, and Google Gemini. Ambient desktop daemon operating at ~0.8–1.9 MB of idle RAM with zero window focus theft.

Sotto is an open-source, resource-efficient alternative to closed-source voice dictation tools like Wispr Flow and Superwhisper. It runs as an unobtrusive background service, captures audio via hardware hooks on key-press, streams PCM audio in-memory to cloud speech models (Groq `whisper-large-v3-turbo` or Gemini), strips acoustic hallucinations, and injects clean text directly into the foreground application while preserving the user's existing clipboard contents.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-Megabyte Memory Footprint**: Idles at ~0.8–1.9 MB of RAM with 0.0% CPU usage. Releases dormant working set memory automatically after 45 seconds of idle.
- **Zero Focus Theft**: The floating pill HUD renders via native OS composition (`WS_EX_NOACTIVATE` / `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW` on Windows; Wayland layer-shell / X11 dock on Linux). Typing in code editors, terminals, or browsers is never interrupted.
- **Instant Speech Ingest (0 ms Clipping)**: Dual-stream rolling pre-roll audio buffer covers Bluetooth headset SCO latency. Audio is spliced seamlessly so the first syllable is never truncated.
- **Call-Aware Media Ducking**: Automatically pauses currently playing non-call media sessions (Windows SMTC / Linux MPRIS) during dictation and resumes them smoothly afterward.
- **Acoustic Pre & Post-Processing**:
  - Trailing silence detection (< 0.005 RMS) to eliminate speech trailing artifacts.
  - Trailing hallucination filtering via deterministic regex (removes unwanted "Thank you.", "Bye.", subtitles).
  - Pre-warmed HTTP/2 keep-alive connections for sub-350ms round trips.
- **Non-Destructive Clipboard & Direct Typing**: Uses native input synthesis (`SendInput` / `wtype`) and restores user clipboard state seamlessly.

## Performance Benchmarks
| Metric | Sotto | Wispr Flow | Superwhisper | Buzz |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Tech Stack** | Rust + Slint | Electron / Web | Swift / Native | Python + PyQt |
| **Idle Memory (RAM)** | **0.8 – 1.9 MB** | 150 – 300 MB | 80 – 160 MB | 180 – 350 MB |
| **Idle CPU** | **0.0%** | 0.5 – 2.0% | 0.2 – 0.8% | 0.8 – 2.0% |
| **Pipeline Latency** | **~350 ms** | ~500 – 900 ms | ~600 – 1200 ms | ~1500 – 3000 ms |
| **License** | **Open Source (MIT/Apache-2.0)**| Proprietary ($12/mo) | Proprietary ($8/mo) | GPL-3.0 |

## Supported Providers & Models
- **Groq Cloud (Default)**:
  - `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (Ultra-fast default, ~250–350ms)
  - `whisper-large-v3` (High multilingual accuracy)
  - Supports API key pool auto-rotation to bypass rate limits.
- **Google Gemini**:
  - `gemini-1.5-flash` / `gemini-2.0-flash` (Direct audio ingestion with prompt customization)

## Global Shortcuts & IPC Control
- Default Trigger: `Ctrl+Shift+Space` (or configurable single-key triggers like `F8`, mouse chords).
- IPC Socket: `127.0.0.1:49281`
- CLI Commands:
  - `sotto` - Launch daemon or restore Studio window
  - `sotto --toggle` - Trigger recording toggle via local IPC (ideal for Linux window managers / Hyprland / Sway / i3)
  - `sotto --status` - Check daemon operational health

## Key Source Files & Architecture
- [desktop/src/main.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/main.rs): Application entry point, Slint UI event loop, single-instance TCP IPC listener.
- [desktop/src/audio/recorder.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/audio/recorder.rs): Audio stream capture via `cpal`, rolling pre-roll buffer, headset handshake splicing.
- [desktop/src/audio/filter.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/audio/filter.rs): Silence gating and RMS energy audio truncation.
- [desktop/src/router/groq.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/router/groq.rs): Pre-warmed HTTP/2 client for Groq Whisper with system anti-hallucination prompting.
- [desktop/src/cleaner/sanitizer.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/cleaner/sanitizer.rs): Deterministic post-processing regex filters for Whisper closing hallucinations.
- [desktop/src/inject/mod.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/inject/mod.rs): Non-destructive text injection and clipboard preservation.
- [desktop/src/hotkey/mod.rs](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/src/hotkey/mod.rs): Low-level keyboard and mouse chord triggers.
- [desktop/ui/hud.slint](file:///D:/whiper-mobile/desktop/ui/hud.slint): Slint HUD overlay and Studio configuration window.

## How to Build & Run
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/criticalstrike18/sotto.git
cd sotto/desktop

# Run with Cargo
cargo run --release

# Run unit and integration tests
cargo test
```
